topic.angle: Why a camera sensor's colour filter is half green

card.title: Half of a camera’s colour filter is green

body.question: A camera sensor sees colour through a tiny red, green or blue filter over each photosensor. What share of a Bayer filter is green?
body.reveal: The pattern is half green, one quarter red and one quarter blue. Bryce Bayer used twice as many green elements to mimic the human eye. Software then interpolates the missing colour information at each pixel.

probes.question: Why does the Bayer filter use twice as many green elements?
options: To mimic the physiology of the human eye

probes.question: True or false: the Bayer filter pattern is half green, one quarter red and one quarter blue.
